============================================================

                        CLEAN GLIDES
                macOS INSTALLATION GUIDE

============================================================

1. INSTALLATION
------------------------------------------------------------

Format:        @FORMAT@
Architectures: @ARCHS@ (macOS @MINOS@ or newer)
               Your DAW automatically loads the matching build.
Requirements:  A DAW that supports @FORMAT@ plugins.

  1. Close your DAW (Digital Audio Workstation).
  2. Open this disk image.
  3. Drag "@NAME@" onto the "@DESTLABEL@" shortcut.
  4. If prompted, choose "Replace" to overwrite an older version.
  5. macOS quarantine removal may be necessary for the plugin
     to work. Please read the Security Notice below to learn
     how to proceed.
  6. Restart your DAW.

2. macOS SECURITY NOTICE - QUARANTINE
------------------------------------------------------------

IMPORTANT: This release is not notarized by Apple.

macOS uses Gatekeeper and quarantine metadata to help protect
your computer from potentially unsafe downloaded software.

Because Clean Glides is not notarized, macOS may prevent the
plugin from loading.

If you have independently verified that you trust this
software and obtained it from the official Clean Glides
distribution, you may choose to remove its quarantine
metadata.

SECURITY DISCLAIMER:

Removing quarantine metadata bypasses an additional macOS
security check. It does NOT verify the software, establish
its integrity, or guarantee that it is safe.

Only proceed if you understand and accept this risk.
Never execute commands from an untrusted source.

HOW TO OPEN TERMINAL:

  1. Press Command (⌘) + Space on your keyboard.
  2. Type "Terminal".
  3. Press Return.

REMOVE THE QUARANTINE ATTRIBUTE:

  1. Copy and paste the following command into Terminal:

       sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "@DESTPATH@/@NAME@"

  2. Press Return.
  3. macOS will request your administrator password.
  4. Enter your password and press Return.

  NOTE: Terminal does not display characters while you type
  your password. This is normal.

  This command removes quarantine metadata recursively from
  this plugin bundle only. It does not disable Gatekeeper
  globally.

  5. Restart your DAW after completing these steps.
